# NEW 2026-11-22 v10.0 Worker 3: Playable Jurchen/Manchu Eight Banners & Shanhaiguan (oe_pmch_, Slot 80). Generated by gen_playable_manchu.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Playable Jurchen/Manchu host: MCH directly OR any non-rebel Jurchen-group tribe
# (JEC, HNE, ASU, HDA, HOI, ULA, YEH, ODO, HUL, WEJ, etc.). Never uses non-existent QNG or JNZ tags!
oe_pmch_is_host = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		tag = MCH
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:jurchen_group }
	}
}

# Country scope. Central Plains defender facing Manchu at Shanhaiguan (Ming or surviving Great Yuan).
oe_pmch_is_central_plains_defender = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		tag = MNG
		tag = CHI
		tag = YUA
	}
}

# Country scope. True when a Central Plains hegemon is sufficiently stressed to open the Shanhaiguan crisis.
oe_pmch_defender_stressed = {
	OR = {
		stability < 15
		AND = {
			country_exists = c:MCH
			is_at_war_with = c:MCH
		}
		AND = {
			country_exists = c:JEC
			is_at_war_with = c:JEC
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_ent_index }
			var:oe_ent_index >= 55
		}
		trigger_else = { always = no }
	}
}

# Any scope. True if a Jurchen/Manchu contender is strong enough to trigger oe_sit_manchu_pass.
oe_pmch_contender_ready = {
	OR = {
		country_exists = c:MCH
		has_global_variable = oe_pmch_jurchen_unifier
	}
}

# Any scope. True if the Manchu/Jurchen contender has conquered Dadu or secured the Shanhaiguan-Ningyuan corridor.
oe_pmch_pass_conquest_achieved = {
	OR = {
		has_global_variable = oe_pmch_pass_force_conquest
		AND = {
			country_exists = c:MCH
			c:MCH = {
				OR = {
					owns = location:dadu
					AND = {
						owns = location:funing
						owns = location:ningyuan_jinzhou
						at_war = no
					}
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { country_exists = c:MCH }
			location:dadu = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = { oe_pmch_is_host = yes }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = oe_pmch_pass_pressure
			global_var:oe_pmch_pass_pressure >= 95
			location:funing = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = { oe_pmch_is_host = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. True if Manchu failed to breach the Pass for 15 years or lost Shenyang & Liaoyang.
oe_pmch_pass_repelled_achieved = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = oe_pmch_pass_months
			global_var:oe_pmch_pass_months >= 180
			NOT = {
				location:dadu = {
					has_owner = yes
					owner = { oe_pmch_is_host = yes }
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				location:funing = {
					has_owner = yes
					owner = { oe_pmch_is_host = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			location:shenyang = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = { oe_pmch_is_central_plains_defender = yes }
			}
			location:liaoyang = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = { oe_pmch_is_central_plains_defender = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. True if both sides exhaust into a Great Wall partition & Liaodong horse-market truce.
oe_pmch_pass_stalemate_achieved = {
	OR = {
		has_global_variable = oe_pmch_pass_stalemate_req
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = oe_pmch_pass_months
			global_var:oe_pmch_pass_months >= 120
			has_global_variable = oe_pmch_pass_pressure
			global_var:oe_pmch_pass_pressure >= 35
			global_var:oe_pmch_pass_pressure <= 65
			location:dadu = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = {
					oe_pmch_is_central_plains_defender = yes
					at_war = no
				}
			}
			location:shenyang = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = {
					oe_pmch_is_host = yes
					at_war = no
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. True when Russian counterpart exists for Nerchinsk / Kyakhta frontier treaty.
oe_pmch_has_russian_partner = {
	OR = {
		country_exists = c:RUS
		country_exists = c:MOS
	}
}
